description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, MAG and MND +30% (25s)] and [Haste], grants [High Quick Cast 2], [Awoken Black Magic], [Damage Cap +10000], [Protean Mode (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)] and [Brave Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Black Magic
description.text: Black Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Protean Mode (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind] after using a Fire/Ice/Earth/Wind ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%
